verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance and security platform, so AI-drafted security questionnaire answers are a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack never documents questionnaire ingestion or AI-drafted answers for review. The nearby evidence covers other things: a human vCISO who helps 'pass security reviews', a Trust Center, Fieldwork AI agents that collect control evidence, and an MCP server that is only a building block. None of these is the questionnaire-answering capability itself.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
